title: Add opt-in setting to skip draft PR builds
summary: AL-Go now offers an opt-in setting to skip draft pull request builds, reducing unnecessary compute consumption before changes are ready for review. The feature adds draft guards to built-in jobs and enables the ready_for_review trigger while keeping custom jobs untouched.
key_points: New skipDraftPullRequests setting (default false) allows repositories to opt out of building draft PRs
When enabled, draft guards are applied to AL-Go built-in jobs and ready_for_review trigger is added to PR build workflows
Supports both pull_request and pull_request_target triggers while leaving merge-queue builds unchanged
Custom jobs remain unmodified, allowing repository owners to manage their own draft conditions
Feature applies after dependency build generation and before custom jobs are appended
quote: Adds `skipDraftPullRequests` (default `false`) so repositories can opt out without changing existing behavior.
